_comment: Real Q2 MXFP4 proof-by-construction tree, exported from the portal. Every artifact_sha256 is the content address of an ACTUAL proof of record. proof_kind: 1=cell-proof (SPICE, from transistors), 2=equivalence (netlist==RTL), 3=techmap-equivalence (maps only onto proven PDK cells), 4=composition-proof (built from proven children). The bottom three are sky130 PDK cells: `commons`, free to reference forever. A techmap-proven block lists as children the PDK cells its proof certifies it maps onto. ref_price_wei paces recovery of recovery_target_wei, the lister-declared listing gas; once recovered the certificate is free. Amounts are illustrative listing-gas estimates a lister declares. Blocks are leaf-first, so every child is registered before it is referenced.
spec: MXFP4 (OCP Microscaling FP4, E2M1) GEMM accelerator on sky130

blocks.name: sky130_fd_sc_hd__inv_1 (PDK cell)
blocks.interface: sky130_fd_sc_hd__inv_1 v1: Y = !A; SPICE-proven exhaustive truth table from the PDK transistor models

blocks.name: sky130_fd_sc_hd__nand2_1 (PDK cell)
blocks.interface: sky130_fd_sc_hd__nand2_1 v1: Y = !(A & B); SPICE-proven exhaustive truth table from the PDK transistor models

blocks.name: sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfxtp_1 (PDK cell)
blocks.interface: sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfxtp_1 v1: Q <= D on posedge CLK; SPICE-proven capture, hold, and edge-exclusivity

blocks.name: E2M1 decoder
blocks.interface: E2M1 decoder v1: in bits[3:0] MX FP4 (1 sign, 2 exp, 1 mant); out {sign, exp[1:0], mant, is_zero}; combinational

blocks.name: FP32 normalize/pack unit
blocks.interface: FP32 normalize/pack v1: in {sign, exp[9:0], mant[24:0]} unnormalized; out IEEE754 binary32; round-to-nearest-even; combinational

blocks.name: 32-way adder-reduction tree
blocks.interface: 32-way reduction tree v1: in 32 x product terms; out sum; associative add reduction; pipelined depth log2(32)=5

blocks.name: FP32 accumulator adder
blocks.interface: FP32 accumulator adder v1: acc' = acc + x; IEEE754 binary32; single-cycle add with normalize

blocks.name: 32-bit register
blocks.interface: 32-bit register v1: q <= d on posedge clk; proven to map only onto dfxtp_1 cells

blocks.name: MXFP4 lane multiplier
blocks.interface: MXFP4 lane multiplier v1: in two E2M1 operands + shared block scale; out FP product term; combinational

blocks.name: MXFP4 dot-product
blocks.interface: MXFP4 dot-product v1: in two length-32 MXFP4 vectors + scales; out FP32 dot; = 32 lane_mult -> adder_tree32 -> fp32_normalize

blocks.name: MXFP4 accumulating PE
blocks.interface: MXFP4 accumulating PE v1: acc' = acc + dot(a,b); one dot_product feeding one fp32_accum; DRC-clean, LVS-match, timing-met signoff on sky130

blocks.name: 16x16 MXFP4 output-stationary GEMM tile
blocks.interface: 16x16 output-stationary GEMM tile v1: 256 accumulating PEs; in A row-stream + B col-stream; out 16x16 FP32 C

blocks.name: MXFP4 GEMM accelerator
blocks.interface: MXFP4 GEMM accelerator v1: tiled GEMM over 16x16 tiles with register-staged operands; top-level system
